title: Schedule of Workers-Affected Amounts on Late Batches — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
On a late regular payroll batch of a Paystride Payroll Card Program, an amount for the workers affected is added to the late-fee charge by the cards the batch loaded:

| Cards the batch loaded | Amount added to the late-fee charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| 250 cards or more | 25.00 |
| at least 100 but fewer than 250 cards | 10.00 |
| fewer than 100 cards | nothing |

### Notes to the schedule

1. The cards counted are the cards loaded by that batch, as its batch entry records them.
2. The two thresholds are 100 cards and 250 cards; each is inclusive at its lower edge.

### Edge cases (hypothetical)

| Cards loaded | Amount added |
|---|---|
| 99 | nothing |
| 100 | 10.00 |
| 249 | 10.00 |
| 250 | 25.00 |

A hypothetical late-fee charge of 41.80 on a batch that loaded 312 cards becomes 66.80 with the 25.00 added.
